about: The needs every new project starts with. Each need feeds a REQUIRED artifact of US-SPEC-15 (A-INI-2 charter, A-PLN-1 requirements, A-PLN-2 specification). The walkthrough is generated from the register these become, so it differs per person: what the idea already answers is derived and never asked. profile_key maps an answer to the person's profile.

needs.label: Who it is for
needs.question: Who is this for?
needs.why: It decides the words, the look and what gets built first.
needs.cue: For example: members of my chess club, or customers of my bakery.
needs.default_consequence: The first version is written for a general reader; say who it is for at any time.

needs.label: The first thing it should do well
needs.question: What is the first thing it should do well?
needs.why: The first working version is built around this one thing.
needs.cue: For example: show this week's opening hours, or collect sign-ups.
needs.default: the main thing your idea describes
needs.default_consequence: We start with our best reading of your idea; you can redirect it after the first demonstration.

needs.label: How you will know it is working
needs.question: How will you know it is working?
needs.why: This becomes the number the system watches and tries to improve.
needs.cue: Similar projects most often watch how many people use it.
needs.default_consequence: The system optimizes for use; change the measure at any time and it re-plans.

needs.label: Private details about people
needs.question: Will it hold private details about people?
needs.why: Private details need protection built in from the start.
needs.cue: Names with addresses, health notes or payment details count as private.
needs.default_consequence: This one has no safe guess; work that depends on it waits for your answer.

needs.label: Monthly running cost
needs.question: How much may this cost to run each month?
needs.why: It sets the spending limit the system must stay under.
needs.cue: Most small projects start on free plans.
needs.default_consequence: Nothing is spent; raise the limit when you want more.

needs.label: What to call it
needs.question: What should we call it?
needs.why: The name appears on the page and in every report.
needs.cue: A working name is fine; many projects rename later.
needs.default_consequence: It is shown as Untitled project until you name it.

needs.label: Who looks after it day to day
needs.question: Who looks after it day to day?
needs.why: It decides how much the system does without waiting for you.
needs.cue: Most owners let the system run it and only make the big decisions.
needs.default_consequence: The system runs it and brings you decisions; you can take over any part later.

needs.label: How much detail you see
needs.question: How much detail do you want to see?
needs.why: It sets how much each screen shows you.
needs.cue: Most people start with the headline and open more when curious.
needs.default_consequence: Screens stay short; switch to more detail at any time.

needs.label: How often it checks on itself
needs.question: How often should it check on itself?
needs.why: More frequent checks notice problems sooner and cost slightly more.
needs.cue: Once an hour suits most projects.
needs.default_consequence: It checks hourly; change it at any time.
